summary: Mid-cycle currency conversion caused provisional credit reallocation across cost-centers; invoice shows negative line on reserve buffer
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports a negative invoice line that appeared after we applied a mid-cycle currency conversion for their organization. Impact: Fjord Analytics sees a -€1,248.00 provisional line (Reserve Buffer Adjustment) on their March invoice; they are concerned this will affect autopay and accounting. Environment: prod tenant bound to eu-west region; org-level billing using EUR but originally migrated from USD mid-billing-cycle.

Observed behavior: After the org currency switch on 2026-03-05, our hourly smoothing job recalculated reserved hours and applied a retroactive FX revaluation that redistributed provisional credits between two cost-centers inside the org. The resulting reallocation created a negative line item labelled "reserve_buffer_reclassification" for -€1,248.00 on the provisional invoice.

Expected behavior: Mid-cycle currency changes should create neutral adjustments (paired positive/negative lines) or be deferred until cycle boundary. Reserve buffer reallocations should never leave a negative finalized charge without explanatory positive offset on the same invoice.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Org A (USD) migrates billing currency to EUR on 2026-03-05 via console.
2) The hourly smoothing and reserve reconciliation job runs between 2026-03-05 and 2026-03-06.
3) Postback ordering causes some hourly postbacks to be reconciled under old-currency timestamps and others under new-currency timestamps.
4) Billing aggregation revalues historic USD lines into EUR with FX rates from daily rate table.
5) The revaluation path uses a rounding step that runs after reserve allocation, leading to a net negative residual applied to cost-center B.

customer_message: (From customer) We changed our billing currency to EUR on Mar 5 and now see a negative "reserve buffer" line on the provisional invoice. Our finance team cannot accept negative charge lines without explanation — please reverse or provide an offseting credit and a clear explanation we can send to accounting. This blocks autopay.

Fjord Analytics (Finance) 2026-03-11: We need a formal credit memo we can attach to the invoice — escalation to billing manager requested.
Diego Morales 2026-03-12: Temporarily placed provisional hold on autopay and scheduled a targeted refund/credit for -€1,248.00 pending final reconciliation.
investigation_notes:
Hypothesis: When org currency changes mid-cycle we convert historic USD postbacks to EUR using daily FX rates. There is a rounding/truncation step executed after reserve allocation which can leave an orphan residual. In multi-cost-center orgs the residual was assigned to cost-center B without creating the positive balancing line against cost-center A due to out-of-order postback reconciliation. Reproducer: force currency switch in dev, replay mixed-order postbacks; observe residual.
Evidence: billing logs show reserve_alloc_rounding_residual negative applied; reconciler test run produced paired offsets when rounding executed before reallocation.
Mitigations considered: 1) Hold conversion until cycle end (requires policy change). 2) Change code to do rounding after creating paired offset lines. 3) Auto-emit a balancing ledger entry when residual != 0. Chosen: patch reconciler to emit balancing ledger entry and re-run reconciliation for March provisional run.
resolution: Workaround applied 2026-03-12: Billing team emitted a manual balancing credit memo for +€1,248.00 into the Fjord Analytics provisional invoice and suspended autopay for the org until customer confirms. Permanent fix planned: reconciler PR to ensure rounding/balancing ledger entries are created during FX revaluation (PR github.com/redwood-inference/billing-reconciler/pull/1297). Follow-up tasks: run a re-reconciliation for the impacted hourly windows (2026-03-05 to 2026-03-06) and add unit tests covering mid-cycle currency switch ordering.
follow_up_tasks: 1) Deploy reconciler PR to staging and run end-to-end job for a mirror org. 2) Reconcile March provisional and emit finalized credit memo if needed. 3) Update runbook: 'currency-change-midcycle' to recommend delaying currency switch to cycle boundary or trigger on-demand full revaluation job. 4) Notify finance + CS of remediation and provide formal credit memo PDF.
final_status_note: 2026-03-12: Manual credit issued and autopay suspended. Customer confirmed receipt of credit memo and acknowledged delay to finalize invoice; ticket remains in Triage until re-reconciliation completes and PR is merged.
